plan.disposition: External Branch A plan review (--mode iterate over the mini-plan, --mode architecture over architecture_brief.md) already completed earlier in this same run, before a mid-session context compaction. Findings, verdicts, and triage decisions are documented in the iterate spec's ## External LLM Review section (provenance/provenance_ref validation tightened per the iterate-mode leg; architecture-mode's provenance-necessity suggestion declined with rationale). The raw provider JSON needed for record_review_pass's structured external-review-json parser was not preserved across the compaction, so this pass cannot be replayed through the tool; recording not_run rather than fabricating a payload.

findings.finding: The capture_session_id.py hook's own reference section still documented only SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID being appended to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.
Values written into CLAUDE_ENV_FILE were unescaped; a value with shell metacharacters could inject arbitrary shell content when the file is sourced.
`where` was computed from the unresolved --commit ref before it was reassigned to the resolved SHA, so error messages showed the wrong value.

Claim under doubt: provenance-consistency plus build_ack's guard means an ack cannot be produced except through record_ci_supplychain_ack.py — write_ack() — the function that actually writes the file — called refuse_if_campaign_runner_context() nowhere; only build_ack() and CLI main() did. A hand-built ack dict passed straight to write_ack() bypassed both.
findings.suggestion: add the guard call to write_ack() itself

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the operator recovery path (act from the orchestrator's own shell once the unit has returned) is reliably reachable — CLAUDE_ENV_FILE's SHIPWRIGHT_LOOP_UNIT_ID write was append-only-if-different-value, never removed a stale line once a var became absent, so a prior unit's export could linger indefinitely and block the documented recovery path if the file is shared across a session.
findings.suggestion: sync the export lines to the hook's current ambient environment each SessionStart, clearing lines for vars that are now absent

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: SHIPWRIGHT_LOOP_UNIT_ID unambiguously identifies an active campaign sub-iterate runner — shipwright-build's --autonomous loop sets the same var around its own section-builder spawn (autonomous-loop.md Step 3b), unrelated to campaigns, so the guard's docs/messages described a narrower trigger surface than actually exists.
findings.suggestion: broaden the guard's language to name any autonomous-loop unit, not only campaign runners
